About

A tight menu, cooked with intention.

Cook-Shop is Chef O's modern take on the Jamaican cook shop — a small, focused kitchen on Oak Street where every plate is made to order rather than held under a heat lamp. The menu stays short on purpose.

Oxtail braises low and slow. Jerk chicken goes on the smoker before it hits the grill. Regulars come back for the same three or four dishes — and keep finding reasons to try another.

Made to order Real scotch bonnet heat Closed Mondays
